title: The Ink That Revealed a Forgery
short_teaser: Researchers can examine ink chemistry, paper fibers, and aging patterns to test whether a document belongs to the period it claims.
story: Researchers can examine ink chemistry, paper fibers, and aging patterns to test whether a document belongs to the period it claims. Evidence becomes powerful when several small clues point in the same direction. Discovery begins when attention stays with what does not fit long enough for a better explanation to emerge. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
